author: cli
text: Re-read at the --replaces change. The comment describing this as the text form of review() is unchanged and accurate. It gained one branch: when an entry carries `replaces`, the rendered pair shows 'because: …' under the supersession line. That is the point of the field - a pair of texts leaves the reader to infer why the belief changed, and the why is the part that does not survive in anybody's head.
